zh: 新手引导的工具步骤改为渲染真实页面：数据抓取、数据导入、报表看板、一键催办、月报和大屏用的是真实页面的静态快照（数据已匿名、不运行脚本、不请求接口），文字清晰、秒开；运维待办直接用真实的待确认面板展示示例草稿，高亮框对准每页的重点元素。
en: Product tour tool steps now render real pages: Data Capture, Data Import, Reports, One-Click Follow-Up, Monthly Report and Big Screen use static snapshots of the real pages (anonymized data, no scripts, no API calls), so text is sharp and they open instantly. Ops Drafts shows a sample draft in the real review panel, and the highlight targets the key element on each page.
